title: UCL AMR resistance target row v2
description: Schema for each row of resistance_targets_v2.csv. Blank values remain unassigned; numeric zero is a structural prior or benchmark, never missing.

value.description: Unit-interval target value, or blank when no target is assigned.

cell_status.description: Existing statuses retained. legacy_unclassified_missing includes unassigned withdrawn cells identified by the revision audit and rationale.

include_in_score.description: Static eligibility under the unchanged model potency and component rules; run-dependent filters can still exclude a row.

score_exclusion_reason.description: Semicolon-delimited stable reason codes when include_in_score is false.

provenance_class.description: Evidence/provenance category. Structural priors are explicit modelling conventions, not direct empirical prevalence. Missing withdrawn targets remain not_assigned.

source_id.description: Foreign key to resistance_target_sources_v2.csv. Review records may document why an unassigned target was withdrawn.

uncertainty_lower.description: Blank unless a separately justified uncertainty bound is available; zero structural priors have no invented 0-0 interval.

uncertainty_upper.description: Blank unless a separately justified uncertainty bound is available; zero structural priors have no invented 0-0 interval.

evidence_weight.description: Reserved for a future evidence-quality decision; no weights assigned in this review.

score_row_weight.description: Documents equal static row weighting before component weights.
